messages:
maya: Quick sync request — Acme asked for tenant-level version pinning + a soft-fallback to hosted baseline. Need a short PRD + rollout plan. Who owns scope decisions for pin expiration and experiment gating?

maya: Requirements we need to confirm: 1) pin TTL (default 24h?), 2) opt-in vs opt-out, 3) telemetry to validate quality delta, 4) rollback SLOs and automatic fallback.

tara: I can draft the PRD. Proposal: default TTL 48h, tenant opt-in via route header `x-tenant-pin`, and a canary phase at 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h windows.

sam: Please include acceptance criteria: - no >3% latency tail increase for pinned traffic, - quality regressions measured on prompt set < 1% drop in pass-rate, - error budget threshold that triggers auto-unpin.

jules: Edge cases: what if pinned model gets OOM on specific sequence lengths? Need a fallback policy: route to compatible quantized variant in same region, then to hosted baseline. Also define metrics to detect OOM vs transient infra flakiness.

arthur: Rollback criteria suggestion: immediate rollback if 5xx rate doubles for pinned tenants OR if latency p95 increases > 200ms for 10m sliding window. Also add a manual hold flag for support to freeze pins per-tenant.

maya: Good. For experiments: design A/B where pinned tenants are bucketed but maintain a mirrored control set for quality evals. We need daily aggregated diffs and an automated alert rule when quality delta > threshold.

tara: Draft will include: scope (api + console pin UI), acceptance criteria (sam's list), rollout stages (dev -> staging -> 5% canary -> 25% -> gradual), observability (per-tenant dashboards + prompt-level repros), rollback steps.

sam: Can we add a safety net: if rollout triggers auto-unpin, system should notify workspace owners + create a ticket in #support-ops with stack and sample prompts.

jules: Also include an edge-case test: long-running KV cache interactions when switching variants mid-session. Add unit tests to ensure cache invalidation is explicit when pin changes.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary-group=tenant-pin-v1, target=5%, window=6h. Notifying oncall @arthur.

maya: Next steps: Tara to share a one-page PRD by EOD with the exact acceptance metric thresholds. Sam/jules/arthur to review and mark blockers. I'll coordinate customer comms for Acme. :thumbsup:

tara: I'll post the PRD link here when ready. Expect 1800 UTC.
